mobbin:79f64251-2c1a-4751-9926-1ab5aa922.summary: The user gets a studio ready, starts 'Record', sees a cancelable countdown, records with timer, pause, retake and stop, then opens an editor with upload progress and 'Add to project'.
steps: Recording with timer, Retake, Pause, Stop
steal: A countdown shows 'Click anywhere to cancel' and 'Starting' before 'REC' begins (screen 2).
During recording, a timer sits with 'Retake', 'Pause' and 'Stop' as equal actions (screen 3).
When paused, the main action becomes red 'Resume' while 'Retake' and 'Stop' stay available (screen 5).
After stop, a review player appears with 'Uploading %' then 'Add to project' or 'Delete' (screens 6-7).
avoid: A Scenes upsell dialog on pause distracts from 'Resume' and 'Stop' for operators who only need recording controls.
mobbin:79f64251-2c1a-4751-9926-1ab5aa922.fit: Recording: maps to control-room start-stop outside the SRV with countdown, pause, retake and processing after stop. The SRV stays the review place once the file exists.

mobbin:e774e41f-3fa0-4fe8-90a9-a784b9336.summary: On the ready-to-record screen the user opens the mic menu, chooses 'Mute Microphone', then sees 'Your microphone is muted. Unmute' and a red 'Unmute' control before 'Record'.
steps: Mic menu with 'Mute Microphone' in red
steal: A warning above the stage says 'Your microphone is muted. Unmute' and can be closed (screen 3).
Toolbar 'Unmute' turns red with a slash while 'Record' stays available, so the warning does not block recording (screen 3).
The mic menu lists devices and a red 'Mute Microphone' action as an explicit choice (screen 2).
mobbin:e774e41f-3fa0-4fe8-90a9-a784b9336.fit: Recording: an explicit muted-mic warning before recording outside the SRV addresses audio failing at centers, without changing Transcript or Annotation tabs.
